prayerExcerpt.en-US: A soul must here learn the heavenly spirit, and be well versed in the occupations of the blessed, that hopes to reign with them hereafter.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Uma alma deve aprender aqui o espírito celestial, e estar bem versada nas ocupações dos bem-aventurados, se espera reinar com eles no porvir.

meta.face: A Greek of Antioch of about sixty with a warm, light olive complexion and a STRONG face WIDEST at the CHEEKBONES, which stand out broad and high — a straight forehead under thick, WAVY iron-grey hair cut short and only a little RECEDING at the temples (NOT bald, no domed crown); MOBILE, strongly ARCHED black-and-grey brows, the right one a little RAISED; LARGE, PROMINENT, expressive dark-brown eyes with the direct, persuasive look of an advocate; a FULL, straight nose with a strong, ROUNDED tip; a WIDE, well-cut mouth with a FULL LOWER LIP, as if about to speak; a medium-length grey beard, close at the cheeks so the line of the jaw shows, ending in a BLUNT POINT. Not the narrow, balding gregory_thaumaturgus, the domed eulogius_alexandria or the tall, egg-shaped anicetus.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The face follows the Menologion of Basil II (grey hair, a grey beard ending in a point, a strong nose), made more animated for the advocate the book describes, and the book's engraving, where he speaks with a raised hand; the dress is the Menologion's bishop's phelonion and omophorion.
